intro: Blood relation questions describe a family in words. Draw a family tree as you read: parents above their children, brothers and sisters side by side.

tips.title: Draw as you read
tips.body: Write down each person as you meet them. Put parents above their children, brothers and sisters side by side, and join husband and wife.

tips.title: Mark who is male and who is female
tips.body: Son, brother, father and husband tell you a person is male; daughter, sister, mother and wife tell you female. "P is the child of Q" tells you neither.

tips.title: Read long phrases one step at a time
tips.body: "My mother's husband's sister": my mother → her husband (my father) → his sister (my aunt).

tips.title: Brothers and sisters share parents
tips.body: If R is S's sister and P is S's father, then P is R's father too.

tips.title: Know the names
tips.body: A father's or mother's brother is an uncle; a son's wife is a daughter-in-law; a sister's husband is a brother-in-law. See the table below.
